chunks: If two of the heirs testify, and they are both just, that is accepted against the heirs. But if they are not just, then that is binding only in their own shares.

key_terms.أُجِيزَ: it was deemed valid and accepted
key_terms.أُلْزِمَا: they were bound or held liable

ai.seo_question: When is the testimony of two heirs binding upon all the heirs in inheritance matters?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the testimony of heirs in matters affecting an estate. When two heirs are upright and just, their testimony is accepted against all the heirs; if they lack justice, its effect is limited to their own portions.
